method: per-id probe for morphisms; union of physics_id fields for objects
known_gaps: The API exposes no full problem catalogue; only the top 100 by solvent index.
Morphisms are discoverable only per problem id. A numeric sweep must reach ~80590; an earlier capture capped at 6000 and missed 31 problems in the 50184..80590 range.
Records whose math_id is non-numeric (AIM-*, MW-*, SIM-*, SMA-*) are held in the database but return nothing from /api/morphisms/:id; see unserved_ids.json.
physics_objects counts objects reachable from captured morphisms, not all declared objects.
